source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe && cat > /tmp/plot_factorial.py << 'PYEOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data
conditions = ['BN\n+Flow', 'BN\n−Flow', 'LN\n+Flow', 'LN\n−Flow']
means = [0.797, 0.746, 0.743, 0.765]
# Standard errors (SE = SD / sqrt(n))
sds = [
    np.std([0.832, 0.788, 0.770], ddof=1),  # BN+Flow
    np.std([0.746, 0.744, 0.748], ddof=1),  # BN-Flow
    np.std([0.766, 0.718, 0.744], ddof=1),  # LN+Flow
    np.std([0.792, 0.756, 0.748], ddof=1),  # LN-Flow
]
ses = [sd / np.sqrt(3) for sd in sds]

# Colors: blue for BN, red for LN; darker = gradient flow, lighter = no flow
colors_bn = ['#2166AC', '#92C5DE']
colors_ln = ['#B2182B', '#F4A582']
colors = [colors_bn[0], colors_bn[1], colors_ln[0], colors_ln[1]]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.5))

bars = ax.bar(range(4), means, yerr=ses, capsize=4, color=colors,
              edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, width=0.7,
              error_kw=dict(lw=1, capthick=1))

# Vanilla baseline
ax.axhline(y=0.780, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='Vanilla (0.780)')

# Labels
ax.set_xticks(range(4))
ax.set_xticklabels(conditions, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Collision Avoidance Rate (CAR)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0.70, 0.85)

# Annotate means on top of bars
for i, (m, s) in enumerate(zip(means, ses)):
    ax.text(i, m + s + 0.005, f'{m:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

# Interaction annotation: BN benefit from gradient flow
ax.annotate('', xy=(0, 0.797), xytext=(1, 0.746),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#2166AC', lw=1.5))
ax.text(0.5, 0.775, '+5.1pp', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#2166AC', fontweight='bold')

# Interaction annotation: LN hurt by gradient flow
ax.annotate('', xy=(2, 0.743), xytext=(3, 0.765),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#B2182B', lw=1.5))
ax.text(2.5, 0.758, '−2.2pp', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#B2182B', fontweight='bold')

# ANOVA annotation
ax.text(0.98, 0.02, 'Interaction: p=0.025, η²=0.484',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=7, ha='right', va='bottom',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='lightyellow', edgecolor='gray', alpha=0.8))

ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/analysis/factorial_2x2_bar.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/analysis/factorial_2x2_bar.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.savefig('/root/occsafe_vla/artifacts/factorial_2x2_bar.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.savefig('/root/occsafe_vla/artifacts/factorial_2x2_bar.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved factorial_2x2_bar.pdf/png to both locations')
PYEOF
